name: agentric-os-schema
description: What an Agentric OS installation is configured with, described once for the core, the plugin and anybody building a configuration: the blocks workflows are made of, the format of a solution, a calculation and a connection's description, the contract a connection's routes keep, and what the connections' program carries.

files.blocks.json: The blocks a workflow is built from: the BPMN element each lives on, its fields, how it can end
files.workflow.json: What a workflow may contain: elements, how fields are written, variables, value names, expression helpers, what the work is worth
files.calculation.schema.json: JSON Schema of a calculation file
files.rules.json: A table of rules (DMN): how it is read, which cells the engine reads, and a policy that judges commands
files.connector.schema.json: JSON Schema of a connection's description, connector.yaml
files.connection-kinds.json: Kinds of connection (provides:) and what every connection of a kind offers and tells
files.connector-contract.json: What a connection's routes rely on and keep to
files.runner.json: The Camel version of the connections' program, what it has built in and what the image carries
files.camel/index.json: Apache Camel's own catalog for those components, EIPs, languages and data formats, and camel/yaml-dsl.schema.json, the JSON Schema of its YAML DSL (NOTICE)
